# O2A coding-agent instructions

Read and follow the repository-root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before
non-trivial repository work. It defines when and how to use Palimnex. The
local setup is documented in [docs/PALIMNEX.md](../docs/PALIMNEX.md).
Task-specific repository workflows live under [`.grok/skills/`](../.grok/skills/);
read the matching `SKILL.md` before work that names a skill or matches its
scope.
